在交接件中加入「匯出視圖契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver page manifests, snapshot identity, pre/post-dedup summaries, missing and duplicate IDs, and reproducible query parameters.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Export-view contract: Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 持續變動的索引可能在跨頁搜尋期間改變排序；本課比較固定視圖與每頁重新查詢的證據差異。
knowledge.textEn: A changing index can alter ordering between search pages; compare fixed-view exports with independently refreshed pages.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 匯出完整性需同時檢查唯一數與預期集合；總行數正確仍可能由重複與遺漏互相抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Export completeness requires unique counts and expected-set comparison; duplicate and missing rows can cancel in total counts.

stages.title: 匯出視圖契約
stages.description: 持續變動的索引可能在跨頁搜尋期間改變排序；本課比較固定視圖與每頁重新查詢的證據差異。 使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 建立穩定event_id及相同timestamp的多列，讓排序需要第二鍵才能明確。保存每頁PIT身份、search_after排序值、查詢雜湊與最後成功頁；禁止只存最後時間戳，因同時間的其餘事件可能在重啟時被跳過。
stages.descriptionEn: A changing index can alter ordering between search pages; compare fixed-view exports with independently refreshed pages. Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Create stable event IDs with several rows sharing a timestamp so a second sort key is necessary. Preserve PIT identity, search_after values, query hash and the last committed page. Storing only the last timestamp is insufficient: remaining events at that same time could be skipped when processing resumes.
